title: 完本感言
content_zh:
想了想，还是写篇完本感言。
不知不觉，灵境写了两年，前一年半奋笔疾书，天天熬大夜，后半年就废了，身体上的毛病我已经说过很多次，甚至开过单章详说，就不赘述了。
我能做的就是默默挨骂，默默体检，然后在完本期间调养身体，但你们要相信，确实是身体废了，才导致更新这样。
对于经常网暴我的读者，其实越到后期，我对骂我的读者容忍度越高（当然，前期容忍度也高），毕竟能追到大后期的，都是真爱粉，作为一个作者，怎么忍心责怪真爱粉，就像爸爸不忍心责怪儿子，不，说错了，是儿子不忍心责怪爸爸（狗头）。
话题回归小说本身，灵境这本书，虽然有一些瑕疵，但完成度还是挺高的。四百万的字的书，大部分伏笔都回收了。元子和魔君是同一个人的设定，从开篇就有很多伏笔，一直到结尾，太多了，以至于很多读者都猜到了，身份转变并不突兀，因为有较为完整的大纲。
包括灵境本身的历史伏笔，星辰之主的伏笔等。
小细节上会因为两年的疲劳码字，出现瑕疵和遗忘，但大框架是完整的。有瑕疵、遗忘在所难免，人脑毕竟不是电脑。
这种伪无限流的题材，我是第一次接触，有这份成绩，真的是大家的厚爱了，不胜感激。
我写小说，不求留下什么名著、经典，更不是为了成为大作家在文学领域获得极高的地位。
初衷简单，第一是为了赚钱糊口，第二则是希望写出有趣的故事让读者们快乐，快餐也好，廉价也好，只要能博君一笑，就够了。
写书有几年了，网文的环境跟以前有所不同，大家的戾气越来越重，包括我自己。
能体会到大家的压力，以及在人世间沉浮挣扎的迷茫和钝痛。
咱们大部分都是普通人，享受不到上层阶级的快乐，所以，如果我能让大家每天只花一两毛钱，就体会到精神上的愉悦，哪怕是短暂的几分钟，十几分钟，那我的文字便充满意义。
还有，完本后会有抽奖活动，回馈一下不离不弃的读者们。
全订和盟主的抽奖活动，说过几次了。不过这几天仍然有读者在书评和私信问我，怎么加全订群，所以我再重提一下：小说简介里有加全订群的方式（划重点）。
全订群的抽奖和盟主的礼物，我在完本后会慢慢布置，大家提前踊跃加群，关注抽奖时间，不要错过。
但这几天，容我放空一下自己。
昨天敲完最后一个字，有种如释重负的感觉，但今天漫，也不知道那些我喜欢的国漫、日漫，更新到第几季了，甚至都记不起名字了。
以前习惯了用码字、构思来填充娱乐时间，冷不丁的完本，我竟然有种无所适从的空虚和茫然。
连载期间码字习惯几乎成了肌肉记忆，晚上敲了几百字的番外，然后强迫自己冷静下来了。

番外是想写第三大区，既然说到这里，就讲讲第三大区吧，在本书的构建里，第三大区是作为背景板存在的。
元子前期在第二大区，中途去一趟第一大区，回来后，主线差不多就到尾声了，所以，本来就没打算写第三大区。
太阳之主在第三大区新手村装逼，没意思，也没看点。
倒是写到中期的时候，想过完本后，换個主角，把第三大区的剧情写成番外，或者写第二部。两者都比把第三大区剧情硬塞入本书要强些。
再聊聊新书，新书有模糊的想法了，具体题材不说，毕竟还没定下来。
我打算在完本期间收集资料，充实世界观，就像写论文那样去查资料，列知识。
然后再慢慢构思剧情。
如果一切顺利，就开始存稿，如果不顺利，就换题材。
不过在此之前，我肯定需要养一段时间的身体。
不唠嗑了，大家晚安！
江湖再见！
PS：这次没有先更后改了。
content_en:
After thinking about it, I decided to write a final reflection.
Before I knew it, I had been writing about Spiritual Realm for two years. I worked hard on writing and staying up late every day for the first year and a half, and then it became useless in the second half of the year. I have talked about my physical problems many times, and even wrote a separate chapter to explain them in detail, so I won’t go into details.
All I can do is to be scolded silently, have a physical examination, and then take care of my body during the completion of this book. But you have to believe that it is indeed my body that is broken, which caused the update to be like this.
As for the readers who often bully me online, in fact, the later I get, the more tolerant I become to readers who scold me (of course, the early stage is also tolerant). After all, those who can catch up to the later stage are all true fans. As an author, how can I bear to blame my true fans, just like a father can't bear to blame his son. No, I'm wrong, it's the son who can't bear to blame his father (dog head).
The topic returns to the novel itself. Although the book Spiritual Realm has some flaws, it is still very complete. In a book of four million words, most of the foreshadowing has been recycled. It is assumed that Motoko and Demon Lord are the same person. There are a lot of foreshadowings from the beginning to the end, so many that many readers have guessed it. The identity change is not abrupt because there is a relatively complete outline.
Including the historical foreshadowing of the spiritual realm itself, the foreshadowing of the Lord of the Stars, etc.
There will be flaws and forgetfulness in small details due to two years of fatigue coding, but the overall framework is complete. Flaws and forgetfulness are inevitable. After all, the human brain is not a computer.
This is my first contact with this kind of pseudo-infinite flow subject matter. This achievement is really a tribute to everyone's love, and I am very grateful.
I write novels not to leave behind any masterpieces or classics, nor to become a great writer and gain a high status in the field of literature.
The original intention is simple. The first is to make money for a living, and the second is to write interesting stories to make readers happy. Whether it is fast food or cheap, as long as it can make you smile, that is enough.
It has been a few years since I wrote a book, and the online writing environment is different from before. Everyone is getting more and more violent, including myself.
I can feel everyone's pressure, as well as the confusion and dull pain of struggling in this world.
Most of us are ordinary people and cannot enjoy the happiness of the upper class. Therefore, if I can make everyone experience spiritual happiness by spending only one or two cents a day, even if it is just a few minutes or ten minutes, then my words will be full of meaning.
Also, there will be a lucky draw after the book is finished to give back to the readers who have stayed with me.
We have talked about the lottery between Quanben and the leader several times. However, in the past few days, readers are still asking me in book reviews and private messages how to add people to the group subscription, so I will mention it again: there is a way to add people to the group subscription in the introduction of the novel (emphasis added).
I will slowly arrange the lottery for the all-subscription group and the gifts for the leader after I finish this book. Please join the group in advance and pay attention to the lottery time so as not to miss it.
But these days, let me relax myself.
After typing the last word yesterday, I felt a sense of relief, but today’s comics, I don’t know what season the Chinese and Japanese comics I like have been updated to, and I can’t even remember the names.
In the past, I was used to filling my entertainment time with code words and ideas. When I finished the book in a hurry, I actually felt a sense of emptiness and confusion at a loss.
During the serialization period, the habit of typing almost became a muscle memory. I typed a few hundred words of extras at night, and then forced myself to calm down.
The extra chapter wants to write about the third major area. Now that we have mentioned it, let’s talk about the third major area. In the construction of this book, the third major area exists as a background board.
Motoko was in the second area in the early stage, and went to the first area in the middle. When he came back, the main plot was almost at the end, so he had no intention of writing about the third area.
The Lord of the Sun is showing off in the Novice Village in the third district, which is boring and uninteresting.
But in the middle of writing, I thought about changing the protagonist after finishing the book, and writing the plot of the third area as a spin-off, or writing a second part. Both are harder than the plot in the third areaIt’s better to cram it into this book.
Let’s talk about the new book. I have vague ideas for the new book. I won’t say the specific subject matter. After all, it hasn’t been decided yet.
I plan to collect information during the completion of this book and enrich the world view. I will search for information and list knowledge just like writing a paper.
Then slowly come up with the plot.
If everything goes well, start saving the manuscript. If not, change the subject.
But before that, I definitely need to take care of myself for a while.
No more nagging, good night everyone!
Goodbye Jianghu!
PS: This time there is no change first and then change.
